$comment: About → Planet Scan. planet: look of the 3D planet (colors are hex; seed reshapes the continents; seaLevel 0–1 sets how much is ocean). readout: sections shown in order; each row is { label, value, flavor? } where value is the plain fact and flavor is an optional short planet-joke line (~8 words max). A section may have strip: a list of names drawn as equal decorative segments (never proportions). unexplored: hover-to-reveal redacted lines under 'Classified'. motto: { value, flavor? }. moons: add or remove freely; radius is orbit size in planet radii (keep 1.4–2.1), speed is radians/second, tilt is the orbit's incline in degrees, image is optional.
